decision_change: The prior blanket hold is superseded only for these explicit gene-level author-reported findings. Allele-specific and quantitative curation remain on hold.
limitations: Not a claim that the parent BY4741 strain or the species is resistant.

Reference loci and proteins remain in provenance; source gene symbols remain distinct.
Not transferred to sordarin, sordaricin, or the 2013 sodium-salt assay.
The broader screen, DPH6/DPH7, and other assay types are not imported.
